rationale: Price is holding above the $88.40 invalidation level and the 9-EMA ($88.61), with the last four candles showing a tight consolidation range ($88.70–$89.31) rather than a clean breakdown, suggesting the position hasn't been technically invalidated yet. However, the momentum that justified entry has clearly stalled — price is below VWAP ($89.12), volume has dropped sharply (3,387 on the last candle vs. the 21K spike at entry), and the maximum adverse excursion of -0.84% already exceeds the maximum favorable excursion of 0.25%, indicating the trade has not behaved as expected. With the invalidation stop enforced automatically and only 49 cents of buffer remaining, the risk/reward of actively closing versus letting the stop do its job is marginal; holding is appropriate only because the stop is imminent and price action is not yet decisively bearish.
